risk_note: RV2 (content /v1/config derivation for the CT-25 invite reward; read-only). invite.reward_enabled is true only when the growth.invite_reward.enabled switch is JSON true and the optional InviteRewardBudgetReader port reports a total available budget at least both sides' amount (BR-INV-24 9); the sum and the comparison go through @couli/money (parseFen / addFen / subFen). reward_amount_fen is the per-side amount (08 default 1000). Port missing, null, throwing or non-integer degrades to false without 50001 (warn on throw / non-integer); the port is not called while the switch is off; no cache. The port is implemented and wired by identity B1-35 (shape agreed in notices). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
